marta: Heads-up — after onboarding model rwd/llama-3-13b-quant (v1), prod started returning gibberish outputs and a few endpoints OOM during cold load. We deployed weights from s3://redwood-models/rwd/llama-3-13b/quant/v1/weights.tar. Anyone seen tokenizer mismatches like this in prod?

alex: Can you paste one of the bad outputs + the tokenizer files you used? also which region/runtime (us-west1 or eu-central)?

marta: Bad output example (truncated): "Hello \ud83d\ude3f \ufffd\ufffd\ufffd" — but more usefully we got a runtime error: 
```
ValueError: token id 99999 out of range for vocab size 50265
```
Token snippet from the onboarding test: 
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('s3://redwood-models/rwd/llama-3-13b/tokenizer')
print(tok.vocab_size)  # 50265
print(tok.encode('Hello world'))  # [50256, 314, 99999]
```
We also saw loader OOM on a 24GB GPU while pulling the checkpoint — weights.tar is 46GB, expected ~10GB for 4-bit.

samir: 99999 > vocab_size is a classic mismatch — looks like token ids from a different tokenizer format (byte-level vs HF BPE). Maybe the tokenizer folder uploaded is the original training tokenizer but not the HF wrapper. Also 46GB suggests the quantization step either failed or uploaded the fp32 checkpoint. Did the quantize/convert job log success?

marta: CI shows the convert step returned exit 0 but the artifact size is wrong. logs/convert-1712003100.txt shows: "conversion complete" but no size check. I can pull the exact S3 keys for the tokenizer: s3://redwood-models/rwd/llama-3-13b/tokenizer/{tokenizer.json, merges.txt, vocab.json}.

erin: I'll roll traffic back to v0 for safety. @deploy-bot can you route 100% to rwd/llama-3-13b/quant/v0?

deploy-bot: Routing change initiated by erin. 100% traffic -> rwd/llama-3-13b/quant/v0. ETA ~30s. :white_check_mark:

alex: Triage checklist (short):
- confirm tokenizer files in S3 include HF files (tokenizer.json, merges.txt or tokenizer.model) and that AutoTokenizer loads them without remapping.
- compare tokenizer.vocab_size vs config.json['vocab_size'] (and check for unknown token IDs).
- verify model config (max_position_embeddings) isn't incompatible with runtime.
- re-run quantize step locally and check resulting tar size + sha256.
- if weights are fp32, abort promotion and re-run quantization with same seed.

marta: I'll pull tokenizer.json now and diff it against the HF dump. attaching quick log excerpt: "ValueError: token id 99999 out of range for vocab size 50265" and loader OOM stack: ``RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate ...`` on a g4dn.xlarge-equivalent.

samir: Quick mitigation I'm adding to the onboarding pipeline: after upload run a validation script: 
```bash
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(TOOLING_PATH); import json; print(t.vocab_size); print(json.load(open('config.json'))['vocab_size'])"
```
and fail the promotion if they differ. Also assert weights.tar size < expected_threshold for quantized models. I'll open a PR now.

marta: Thanks — I'll hold v1 out of rotation until we have the PR + a fresh quantize run. If anyone needs the S3 keys or raw logs DM me.

erin: Good plan. Keep this thread updated if the rollback fails or we see customer impact. :eyes:
